blocks.text: The Nokia G310 5G Smartphone is an unlocked blue 128GB model with 5G connectivity.

items: Professionally inspected and fully functional renewed unit — each device has been thoroughly cleaned, tested, and certified to ensure reliable 5G connectivity, smooth performance, and like-new operation.

items.label: Factory unlocked model (TA-1573)
items.value: Compatible with most major GSM carriers including T-Mobile, AT&T, and international networks (not compatible with Verizon or CDMA networks)

items.label: 128GB storage + microSD expansion
items.value: Plenty of space for photos, videos, apps, and downloads with support for expandable storage up to 1TB.

items.label: 6.56" HD+ display with 90Hz refresh rate
items.value: Smooth scrolling and improved viewing clarity for entertainment, apps, and everyday use.

items.label: Triple rear camera system
items.value: Features a 50MP main camera with AI enhancements, depth sensor, and macro lens for sharp photos and detailed close-ups.

items.label: Long-lasting 5,000 mAh battery
items.value: Designed for all-day use with fast charging support for quick top-ups.

items.label: Durable design with QuickFix repairability
items.value: Nokia’s user-friendly design allows easy battery and component replacements using common tools.

items.label: Snapdragon 480+ 5G processor
items.value: Efficient performance for gaming, multitasking, and fast 5G streaming.

items.label: Blue matte finish
items.value: Stylish, comfortable grip with a modern design.

items.label: Rear Facing Camera Photo Sensor Resolution
